Schelling challenges existence while Trendelenburg challenges motion, Marx transforms material relations and Popper attacks retrospective immunity.

required_propositions.claim: Hegelian doctrine cannot be treated as one book because published works and later lectures have different evidential status.
Stuttgart, Tübingen, Bern and Frankfurt precede Jena while the mature system develops across successive locations and works.
The Nuremberg years yield the Science of Logic while Heidelberg produces the Encyclopaedia system and its Nature sections.
Berlin political philosophy distinguishes actuality through ethical life, family, civil society and the constitutional state.
Posthumous history lectures depend on Gans, Karl Hegel and student transcripts, therefore every historical formula requires explicit source caution.
Feuerbach, Trendelenburg, Schelling, Kierkegaard, Marx, Russell and Popper attack or transform different seams rather than one generic doctrine.

required_propositions.claim: Kant limits knowledge to appearances while a negative noumenon restricts cognition without supplying positive supersensible knowledge.
Hegel rejects the external boundary because a determinately known limit is relational and an empty in-itself is thought-produced abstraction.
Fixed dualism blocks explanation while identity-in-difference mediates appearance and reality within one intelligible field.
Rejecting an unknowable remainder does not yield omniscience because the limit argument cannot prove the completeness of Hegelian system.
Kantian limiting-concept readings survive while reified two-world and affection readings face the strongest Hegelian criticism.
The phenomenal world remains real through finite mediated manifestation rather than becoming an independent thing-in-itself or private illusion.

required_propositions.claim: Self-consciousness depends on valuable recognition, therefore two agents enter a life-and-death struggle rather than remain isolated.

The bondsman develops durable agency through fear, disciplined service and formative labour on an enduring object.

Later Marxist, feminist and anti-colonial receptions transform the episode while the primary explanation of dialectic remains logical rather than phenomenological.

required_propositions.claim: Kant limits cognition to appearances while Hegel rejects the fixed noumenal remainder through Absolute Idealism.
Marx transforms contradiction into material social relations while Kierkegaard rejects total system for the existing individual.
Berkeley grounds sensible order in ideas, spirits and God while Hegel treats nature and finite Spirit as moments of the developing whole.

Explaining dialectic requires a mechanism and worked transition rather than stopping at thesis-antithesis-synthesis.

required_propositions.claim: A finite determination destroys itself because the precise form of its failure dictates the determinate successor.
Logical categories, phenomenological shapes and historical institutions develop through distinct registers that cannot substitute for one another.
Absolute Idealism preserves nature and finite minds as real moments while rejecting perception-dependence, a second world and a cosmic person.
Recognition becomes relational and historical without replacing the larger system, while the lord loses the reason for victory.
Eurocentric teleology rationalises victors unless qualified, while Objective Spirit locates freedom through right, morality and ethical life.
The qualified conclusion preserves Hegelian achievements while retrospective necessity, sheer existence and particular irreducibility remain costs.
